question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Option no. (1) **"Devide".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is** "divide". **
 
• It is a verb that means to separate into parts or groups.
 
 
• **Example: **Please divide the pizza into equal slices for everyone.
